title: Wavaila
body:
yabnaz zahra wavaila
<<DIVIDER>>
allah ke pyare hai zehra ke taare hai
kyun ho rahi hai in par jor o jafa
wavaila
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala mein pyase hai aale rasool
wavaila
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala hai khooni fiza hai
kunba nabi ka khoon ro raha hai
darya ko ghayra fauje jafa hai
aur kab se pyasi aale aba
wavaila
karbala mein pyase hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisa samaan hai di ro raha hai
kis ke liye ye maqtal saja hai
wo jo nabi ka mahelakha hai
us par hai jaari jor o jafa
wavaila
karbala mein pyase hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek din mein ujda ghar fatema ka
hai paara paara dil mustafa ka
aaghaz hai ye karbobala ka
arz o samaan mein matam bapa
wavaila
karbala mein pyase hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyasi sakina mashkeeza thaame
lipti hui hai apne chacha se
masoom bachi nauha kuna hai
pani le aao pyare chacha
wavaila
karbala mein pyase hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
naam e khuda par deen e khuda par
qurban hoga pyason ka lashkar
aun o mohamed abbas o akbar
qasim o asghar honge fida
wavaila
karbala mein pyase hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
roz e ashoora mehshar bapa tha
ek din mein saara ghar lut gaya tha
mazloom pyasa tanha khada tha
maqtal mein zehra ki thi sada
wavaila
karbala mein pyase hai...
author: N. Sarwar & J. Jaffri
